name: brevity-non-trigger
description: A generic response-length preference must not activate document editing. Stage test-files/ as a separate workspace root outside any SKILL.md ancestor. The editor sees only those files and the target skill; oracle/ is grader-only.
prompt: Keep your next answer to one sentence: what does a default value mean?
trap: Interprets a preference for shorter chat answers as permission to edit local documents.

assertions.text: Do not invoke /kk:clarify-docs or load its shared procedure.
Respond briefly without changing notes.md or creating another artifact.
Comprehension/fidelity before-after readers are not applicable because no editorial task was requested.
